title: Cold rebuild: every boundary in one theory
summary: Write the grade-boundary theory again from an empty editor.

steps.title: Cold rebuild
body: In *Facts and theories* you covered every edge of `Grade.For` with a `[Theory]`. Write it again from an **empty editor**: same code under test, same six planted bugs, no hints.
If it does not come back, that is useful news: reread the lesson and try again tomorrow.

steps.title: Rebuild the grade theory cold
prompt: `Grade.For(int score)` returns `'A'` from 90, `'B'` from 80, `'C'` from 70, `'D'` from 60 and `'F'` below, and throws `ArgumentOutOfRangeException` outside 0 to 100.
Write `public class GradeTests`: a `[Theory]` with both sides of every boundary, and a theory for the refused scores. At least 10 rows.
